rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Rotate into BTC as the protective, flow-leading major on a tape that just turned risk-off. WTI crude topped 85 dollars for the first time since June, reigniting inflation concerns and driving an explicit 'bitcoin over altcoins' safety rotation — BTC retreated only modestly from a fresh one-month high and is up ~1.7% on the session, showing relative strength AND absorbing the defensive bid while alts lag. BTC is the deepest-liquidity spot major with the cleanest definable stop, giving the best risk-adjusted next-24h payoff on a day when the macro edge for high-beta alts is compromised. Entry 66,036 sits just below the recent one-month high, leaving room to re-test it if risk stabilizes, while the safety-bid backdrop cushions downside if the tape weakens.
positions.driver: Rolled SOL flat (-4.15 dollars) into capital and rotated to BTC. On a low-edge, inflation-driven risk-off day the mandate favors the liquid majors with the most downside protection. BTC wins vs runners-up: SOL (~78.29) keeps the strongest idiosyncratic catalyst stack (every-July-day spot-SOL ETF inflows, Bitwise BSOL +2.64M on 7/21 to 1.14B cumulative, new Morgan Stanley MSOL spot-ETF filing at 0.14% fee, Q3 Alpenglow ~150ms finality, 7/21 tokenized-stock on-chain analytics launch) but is the highest-beta major and only +0.58% today — it falls hardest if the oil/inflation risk-off deepens. ETH (~1,941) is the best day-gainer (+1.44%) but remains the structural laggard with ETF outflows and a live sell-the-news risk. BTC's active safety-rotation bid + momentum + tightest downside give it the best risk-adjusted 24h edge today.
positions.risks: If the oil/inflation shock deepens into a broad risk-off liquidation, even BTC sells off — and it just retreated from a one-month high, so it could be carving a local top rather than basing. A decisive break back below the mid-63k shelf would weaken the momentum thesis. Being the protective major, BTC also gives up upside if risk snaps back on and capital rotates into the higher-beta alts (SOL/ETH) instead. Hard stop 60,753.55 (-8%, majors rule) below the recent range.
